content: Ayɔɔb aŋàlàkwikilà bàkäl anà unkyeey akabyääl anà akamfum a nsi, bàkyer awem, bàkal anà ukwen mukyer ndaa aŋàbwaŋ,
bàkɔɔn atwee akà mbuur mwɛy, bàtiin ngwiy, bàmɛnà aŋukanà, bàswɛŋ duu taaŋ lanswà akà baar banswà.

Ntɔn bi sye itaan, bi kàkäl ipool, baar a un'tswe ngwal, baar aŋàdiimà mbwo, asɔ a ngyal a ifà ifà anà un'sak a ifà ifà, kàkäl uboo a kɔɔrà anà un'köl, baar a ŋingyäy u mii a baar, bi kàyiiŋà bi a bi.
Wɛɛ, umpal bàmɛnà ubwaŋ a Nzam, Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi anà ukwen ande ntɔn baar,
nde kitsü mɔ̈ɔ̈, kà ntɔn bi kàtàkyer isal a balàbal anki, wɛɛ ntɔn ngyɛb ande ŋakwo, u mbwo a an'dà a mböör akün anà yà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Dwelà In'kyɛɛl awà, Nzam kun'pay mbɔɔn udu a bi u mbwo a Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi Yɛsu Klistɔ,
ntɔn nde kitwey bàbalàbal u mbwo a kab a ngway ande, unsà làkyän, bi ibulà awɛɛl a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.

Ndaa ayin yà làkwikilà. Mɛ in'kwen naa ngye asi muküünà unsà indiir abi, ntɔn baar banswà bàfàsà làkwikilà amu Nzam, bàsöönà mukyer isal a ntsà. Indiir abi byà byàntwɛn anà byàndöŋ akà baar.
Wɛɛ, tiin mbaaŋ a ipool, nsim a an'ywar, an'syee, ngwiy ntɔn un'kɔɔn, ntɔn indiir abi ndöŋ byatɛy, bya byà bunàbun.
Mbuur afàtwaal nkaabà, un'lwom ungö a lwɛŋ atàtwɛb anà làyweel:
muyöb naa mbuur a tub awà wàŋàdiimà mbwo anà wun'be, nde afàpɛɛl ikwàndwà nde ŋakwo.
Umpal in'satööm mɛ Artɛmas itàkal Tishik, kyer ngwal muyan'taan u Nikɔpɔlis. Ntɔn mɛ kàbön naa mɛ in'yàkal kwo u paŋà a mpye.
Sà un'kanà mupà Zɛnas awà mbak anà Apɔlɔsi indiir abà ba abyà mfun u nkyeen aba, ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n akal anà nkyääŋ a undiir.
Bàbi ŋakwo sye bàkyer alɔŋàkà mubilà afwee unsà isal a ntsà, ntɔn mukwey ngyal a gyä, anà mukɔɔn akal abwal.
Baar banswà abà anà mɛ bàmapà mbɔr. Apɛ asam abi aŋàkwikilà mbɔr. Wɛy kab a ngway làkäl anà bɛ banswà!
